column1: # Provider specifications served from a URL rather than a git repository.
# A document here has no upstream revision to pin -- Google serves Discovery
# live, and a raw.githubusercontent.com URL tracks a branch -- so the document
# itself is the pin: it is committed under specs/, and a plain `make specs-sync`
# uses the committed copy. SPECS_REFRESH=1 refetches and shows whatever changed
# as a reviewable diff, which is the point: an unannounced vendor change is
# visible exactly because a build never refetches silently.
# A service is fetched only when specs/mirror.set asks for it.
